import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan, Network
from test_compiler import check
from functools import wraps
calls=Network.flow
runtime=[0]; num=[0]
def flow(*args,**kwargs):
    t=time.monotonic(); ret=calls(*args,**kwargs); runtime[0]+=time.monotonic()-t; num[0]+=1; return ret
Network.flow=flow

def case(seed, k, cap=50, demand=10, switch=False):
    random.seed(seed); n=48
    C=random.sample(range(n),k)
    links=random.sample([(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n)],128)
    if switch:
        # star with switches linked, degree around five
        links=[]
        for v in C:
            links.extend([(v,w) for w in random.sample(sorted(set(range(n))-set(C)),3)])
        rest=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in links and (v,u) not in links]
        links+=random.sample(rest,128-len(links))
    env=[[l, random.randint(1,cap)] for l in range(len(links))]
    parts=[[v,random.randint(0,demand)] for v in C]
    t=time.monotonic(); start=num[0]
    plan,cut=compile_plan(n,links,parts,env,1)
    check(n,links,parts,env,1,plan,cut)
    print('seed',seed,'k',k,'cap',cap,'demand',demand,'sec',round(time.monotonic()-t,3),'calls',num[0]-start, 'size', [len(plan[q]) for q in ('trees','routes','recipes')] if plan else 'denied',flush=True)

for k in [2,4,8,16,24,32]:
    for seed in range(3):
        case(seed,k,100,10)
print('Flow time',runtime,'count',num)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B tmp/bench.py
